name: Shrikhand
description: Yogurt hung until thick, then whipped with sugar, saffron and cardamom.

tcm.note: Strained yogurt with warm spices; cooling overall.

ayurveda.note: Dahi is ushna in the classical reading, and the saffron adds to it.

unani.note: Thanda-tar in desi usage — a summer sweet, eaten with puri.

histamine.note: Hung yogurt, held and sweetened — above plain dahi.

effects.note: Shrikhand is hung yogurt, whipped and sweetened, carrying the same live cultures behind yogurt's own lactose-digestion effect — the dedicated trials tested plain yogurt rather than shrikhand itself, but this is the same product, strained and finished, not a different one. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
